characters.name: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen
characters.description: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen is portrayed as a middle-aged man with a robust build. He has a distinguished presence with neatly kept dark hair and a well-groomed beard. His attire reflects the 19th-century fashion, typically a formal dark suit with a vest, and a white cravat. The setting is scholarly or literary, with an intellectual atmosphere emphasizing his role in collecting and editing Norwegian folktales.

characters.name: Jørgen Moe
characters.description: Jørgen Moe is depicted as a gentleman of similar age to Asbjørnsen, sharing a scholarly demeanor. He has softer features, with lighter brown hair and a clean-shaven face. Moe's attire also mirrors the 19th-century style, often a dark suit with a white shirt and a bow tie. His expression conveys a thoughtful and reflective character, aligning with his literary contributions to the folktale collection.

characters.name: Jacob Grimm
characters.description: Jacob Grimm is shown as an older man with sharp, intellectual features. He has a full head of gray hair and a matching beard. His attire is traditional for the early 19th century, featuring a long, elegant dark coat with a high collar and a cravat. The setting is scholarly, reinforcing his reputation as a pioneer in the study of folklore.

characters.name: Wilhelm Grimm
characters.description: Wilhelm Grimm appears as an elder statesman of folklore, with features similar to his brother Jacob but with a rounder face. His hair is gray and thinning, and he sports a pair of spectacles perched on his nose. Like Jacob, his clothing is that of the early 19th-century scholarly attire, complementing the intellectual and literary environment that he is associated with as a creator of the German folkloric tradition.
